feature_contract.goal: Reduce CPU scratch transformation and D3D9 UP submission span for non-zero-base indexed XYZRHW smoke/sand/decal draws without changing the visible vertex/index set or zero-base fast path.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R30 DrawIndexedPrimitiveUP XYZRHW world/HUD conversion; no alpha quality reduction, no render-order batching, no DX11/DXVK, SkyGlow, FFB, DirectGPU transport or user input changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Before this task R30 sizes both eye scratch buffers to minVertexIndex+numVertices and resubmits original absolute indices. The D3D9 declared index window permits an equivalent zero-based local window of exactly numVertices with indices rebased by minVertexIndex.
trace_stages: Game DrawIndexedPrimitiveUP declares a legal minVertexIndex/numVertices window and particle/decal index list.
R30 validates original indices, maps them to local window indices, transforms only numVertices for both eyes, and submits the same triangles at minVertexIndex=0.
R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo keeps existing left/right render-target ordering, depth ownership, alpha blend state and OpenXR composition.
subcomponents: Offset source vertex pointer by minVertexIndex*stride with 32-bit-build overflow guard and size scratch to numVertices.
Keep one-pass sparse local used-mask; copy/rebase index data only when minVertexIndex is non-zero so common zero-base UP calls add no index-copy pass.
Extend the existing exact-SHA R30 index-rebase verifier with 2800 randomized 16/32-bit equivalence models and destructive mutations.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Non-zero-base indexed UP renders the same vertex/index sequence while removing the unreachable prefix from both eye scratch/upload spans.
minVertexIndex=0 retains original index pointer/single scan behavior; invalid/overflowing windows fail open to the original D3D9 path.
Final exact-SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation and relevant Full Source Impact workflows succeed.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30TryXyzrhwIndexedPrimitiveUP used vertexCount=minVertexIndex+numVertices, absolute used-mask indices and original min/index data for both transformed UP eye draws.
diagnosis.root_cause: The legal D3D9 minimum vertex index was treated as required scratch prefix rather than an address base, amplifying CPU copy/transform and driver UP upload span for non-zero-base particle/decal draws.
alternatives_rejected: Changing transparency resolution or alpha quality is not justified without GPU timing and would alter visuals.
Batching render-target transitions across transparent draws risks alpha ordering and state lifetime, so it is not mixed into this source-safe optimization.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: The transformed source pointer advances by minVertexIndex*stride, all used-mask indices become raw-minVertexIndex, and submitted indices are rebased only for non-zero minimums; zero-base caller index data is reused unchanged.

runtime_note: RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED; no Quest3/VDXR FPS/p95/p99 measurement yet. This specifically targets CPU/driver submission amplification and does not claim to solve pure GPU overdraw from glass/water/smoke.
